senses.gloss:
m. (-क्षः)
The sun.
E.
दृश् the sight, त्र्यध्यक्ष ruler.

m. (-लः)
A small circle on the axis of the earth, within the greater circle of the armillary sphere, and accompanying each planetary circle.
E.
दृश्, and गोल circle.

m. (-षः)
A serpent or other such venomous reptile.
E.
दृश eye, and विष poison; whose eye is venomous.
